items.q: Chippie did some of the writing. And I did, of course.

ctx.x: Chippie did some of the writing. And I did, of course.

But the other major writer, who joined us about three months after the band had started in 1944, was a very fine arranger -- his name was Tadd Dameron. Tadd was from Cleveland, Ohio, and an arranger with a very unique style of arranging, and was another one of the indelible stamps on the band. While he was with us, one of the things that he wrote was a composition of Billy Eckstine called "I Want To Talk About You."
